derivation: Original Solo12 URDF expanded with xacro and imported into MuJoCo 3.3.7. Bundled MJCF retains geometry and inertial values; explicit experimental modifications are listed below. No upstream control code is executed.
modifications: Free base and twelve position actuators with 2.5 Nm joint/actuator limits, kp16, kv0.35.
Four 20 mm spherical foot pads, each with 15 g experimental mass.
Base-to-upper-leg assembled convex-hull overlaps excluded from rigid contacts.
Rigid floor and contact settings; 1 ms implicitfast integration.
Classical scheduled crawl and feedback through joint torques, not a learned policy.
preview_geometry: Exact visual mesh arrays used by the released video; historical initial transforms are replaced by recorded transforms during rendering.
